ABOUT ME

Who I Am

I am Shovon Mahali, a Bachelor of Business Administration student at the Institute of Engineering & Management (IEM), with a strong interest in business analytics, finance, technology and emerging financial systems.

My interests span business management, finance, cryptocurrency, blockchain, FinTech, behavioral finance and data-driven decision-making.

I enjoy exploring how data and technology can help businesses understand patterns, evaluate opportunities and make better decisions.

Alongside my academic journey, I have been developing practical experience through publishing, business development, content creation, market analysis and technology-focused learning.

I am currently building my technical foundation in Python, Excel, SQL, data analytics, web development, blockchain and related technologies.

My long-term goal is to combine business knowledge with analytical and technical skills to solve meaningful real-world problems.
